name: io.github.ethereaglehq/privatools
title: PrivaTools
description: Stateless privacy-first PDF, image, document, and media processing tools via PrivaTools API.

tools.name: privatools_list_tools
tools.description: Returns PrivaTools file processing operations filtered by optional keyword, category, or execution mode (sync or async), including slugs, aliases, summaries, response media types, and async support flags.

query.description: Optional keyword search across operation slugs, aliases, summaries, and categories (e.g. 'compress', 'merge', 'ocr', 'watermark').

category.description: Optional case-insensitive category filter (e.g. 'PDF processing', 'Image', 'Audio and video', 'Accessibility').

limit.description: Maximum number of operations to return (1-250, default 50).

tools.name: privatools_describe_tool
tools.description: Returns the HTTP method, upload fields, form and query parameters, constraints, cost, async support, input limits, and response media types for a PrivaTools operation slug or alias.

tools.name: privatools_run_tool
tools.description: Runs a synchronous PrivaTools operation (PDF, image, office, audio/video, QR, OCR, accessibility, and related file tools). Accepts file inputs via public https:// URLs (up to 500 MiB, matching MAX_UPLOAD_MB; up to 2 concurrent fetches per IP, 30s idle timeout, 180s total deadline) or inline base64 (up to 25 MiB decoded JSON-RPC payload cap). JSON-returning operations return data inline; binary outputs (up to 500 MiB) return a short-lived download URL (15-minute TTL) and a resource_link block. Works anonymously without an account; an optional X-API-Key header applies /api/v1 quota. Parameter details for each operation are available from privatools_describe_tool.

file_url.description: Single input file as a public https:// URL (SSRF-protected; up to 500 MiB, matching the website upload cap).

file_urls.description: Multiple input files as public https:// URLs, in order (up to 500 MiB each).

file_base64.description: Single input file encoded as inline base64 (max 25 MiB decoded JSON-RPC cap; larger files up to 500 MiB are accepted via file_url).

filename.description: Optional filename with extension for file_base64 or file_url (e.g. 'report.pdf').

url.description: Public https:// URL to fetch this input file from (SSRF-protected).

base64.description: Base64-encoded file bytes (25 MiB decoded total cap across all base64 inputs).

field.description: Optional multipart upload field name (e.g. 'file1', 'file2') for tools with distinct named file inputs.

files.description: Multiple input files (url or base64) with optional per-file filename and multipart field name.

file_field.description: Optional multipart upload field name override (auto-detected from schema when omitted).

params.description: Optional operation parameters (form fields, JSON body fields, or query params).

tools.name: privatools_submit_job
tools.description: Submits an asynchronous background job for supported heavy operations ('merge', 'compress', 'grayscale', 'pdf-to-text'). Works anonymously out of the box (returning an unguessable capability job_id, subject to per-IP concurrency limits and 1-hour artifact retention) or with an optional X-API-Key / Authorization: Bearer header for key-scoped /api/v1 quotas. Accepts public https:// URLs or base64 PDF inputs. Job progress and results are exposed by privatools_job_status, and early removal or cancellation is handled by privatools_delete_job.

file_url.description: Single PDF input file as a public https:// URL.

file_urls.description: Multiple PDF input files as public https:// URLs, in order.

file_base64.description: Single PDF input file encoded as base64 (max 25 MiB decoded).

url.description: Public https:// URL to fetch this input file from (SSRF-protected).

base64.description: Base64-encoded file bytes (25 MiB decoded total cap across all base64 inputs).

field.description: Optional multipart upload field name (e.g. 'file1', 'file2') for tools with distinct named file inputs.

files.description: Multiple PDF input files (url or base64) in order.

options.description: Optional operation-specific options object (e.g. {'level': 'recommended'} for compress).

idempotency_key.description: Optional Idempotency-Key (1-128 visible ASCII chars) for safe retries. Auto-generated when omitted.

tools.name: privatools_job_status
tools.description: Read-only status check for an asynchronous job that optionally returns a short-lived download link or inline JSON result once succeeded (when include_result is true). Works anonymously with the capability job_id for anonymous jobs, or with the submitting X-API-Key for key-owned jobs under strict owner isolation. Does not delete or cancel jobs; job deletion and cancellation are separate operations provided by privatools_delete_job.

include_result.description: When true and the job has succeeded, also includes a short-lived download_url and resource_link (or inline JSON for pdf-to-text).

tools.name: privatools_delete_job
tools.description: Permanently deletes a completed async job's server-side artifacts or cancels a queued or running job. Works anonymously with the capability job_id for anonymous jobs, or with the submitting X-API-Key for key-owned jobs. Repeated deletion is idempotent.
